  * [[PornHub] Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 410: Gone #16729](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16729)



# External issues

  * [ffmpeg can't seek in Youtube's iOS m3u8 streams / `--download-sections` only downloads audio #9552](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9552)
    * Use `-S proto:https` or `--extractor-args "youtube:player_client=default,-ios"`
  * [`--cookies-from-browser` "Permission denied" errors when Chrome/chromium-based browser is open in Windows #7271](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7271)
    * Try after closing chrome completely OR
    * Launch chrome from command line w/ `chrome.exe --disable-features=LockProfileCookieDatabase`
    * Alternatively, you can [install](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#installing-plugins) the [ChomeCookieUnlock yt-dlp plugin](https://github.com/seproDev/yt-dlp-ChromeCookieUnlock)
  * [`--cookies-from-browser`: WARNING: failed to decrypt with DPAPI / ERROR: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'decode' #10927](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10927)
  * [[youtube] Is downloading a livestream in 1440p or 2160p no longer available? #11262](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/11262)
  * [[Youtube] 8k VR180 SBS videos no longer available #9903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/9903)
    * Use `--extractor-arg "youtube:player_client=android_vr,default"`
  * [[Youtube] throttling and inconsistent speed in Russia #10443](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443)
    * [Workarounds](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10443#issuecomment-2248940967)
  * [[Discord bot] Music stops in the middle #8854](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8854)
  * [[youtube] Endless "Incomplete data received" when downloading playlist #10394](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10394)
    * Don't use `--extractor-retries infinite`
  * [FFMPEG "Invalid data found when processing input" on live/post-live/dash videos (duplicate ftyp) #8641](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8641)
    * Regression in ffmpeg 6.1. Upgrade to ffmpeg 6.1.1 or to [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases) revision `N-112916` or later
  * [[youtube] "Invalid data found when processing input" / ffmpeg errors on HDR VP9 in mp4 #7541](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7541)
    * ffmpeg bug. Upgrade to ffmpeg 7.0.1 or to the latest [master build](https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds/releases)
  * [`--mark-watched` fails with urlopen error #8149](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8149)
    * Disable pi-hole or whitelist `s.youtube.com`
  * [Chapter Embedding Results in Unnamed Chapters When Using Recent FFmpeg Builds #6859](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/6859)
    * ffmpeg regression. Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/FFmpeg-Builds> or upgrade to 6.1.1 or newer
  * [yt-dlp is detected as a virus #25](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/25)
    * It's a false positive. Complain to your vendor. There is nothing we can do
  * [Incomplete Data Recieved #1787](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1787)
    * Broken from Youtube's side. If downloading comments, use `-i` to ignore the error
  * [Wrong year in metadata in M4A, MP4, FLAC format #3087](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3087)
    * Workaround: `--parse-metadata "%(release_year,upload_date).4s:(?P<meta_date>.+)"`
  * [pyinstaller temp files are not cleaned up when using yt-dlp.exe with mpv #10294](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10294)
  * [Long Start-Up Time for `yt-dlp_macos` #10425](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/10425)
  * [`--download-sections` / ffmpeg fails to seek in a 26+ hour long Twitch m3u8 #5372](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5372)
  * [Using proxy and `--download-sections`/ ffmpeg fails with HTTP Error 400/401/403 #12915](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12915)



# FAQ

See <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ>

  * **[How to avoid Youtube's new "Super Resolution" AI-upscaled formats #15325](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15325)**
  * **[Getting deno to work in Termux. #15095 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15095#issuecomment-3544324838)**
    * Run a full Termux upgrade with `pkg update && pkg upgrade` before `pkg install deno`
  * **[[YouTube] Enhanced bitrate no longer available to download? #14133 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14133#issuecomment-3217679575)**
  * [**Filename too long**](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1136#issuecomment-932077195)
    * Use `-o "%(title).150B [%(id)s].%(ext)s"`
  * **[[YouTube]`--write-comments`: "Incomplete data received. Giving up after 3 retries" warnings #15435](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15435)**
  * **[twitter: No video could be found in this tweet #14742](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14742)**
  * [[Question] odd ba* format selection? #979 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/979#issuecomment-919629354)
    * Generally do not use `ba*`
  * [Fix playlist_index's inconsistent behavior #302](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/302)
    * Check `playlist_autonumber` and `--compat-option playlist-index`
  * [yt-dlp python module not compiling with pyinstaller #3845](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3845)
    * Use `bundle/pyinstaller.py`
  * [Subtitle file is not deleted after being embedded #630 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/630#issuecomment-893659460)
    * Use `--compat-option no-keep-subs`
  * [`--download-sections`/`--sponsorblock-remove` does not cut at exact point #4216](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4216) / [YouTube Clip Downloads have unintented extra beginning part with no video #5080](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5080)
    * Use `--force-keyframes-at-cuts`
  * [Duplicating pull request from youtube-dl to yt-dlp #4202](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4202)
  * [How to check in browser if the video is DRM protected](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4062#issuecomment-1153474056)
  * [\--cookies-from-browser for a chrome/firefox like browser or non-default install location #2903](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2903)
  * [What are yt-dlp's error codes? #4262 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4262#issuecomment-1173133105)
  * [Extractor option `language` for `crunchyrollbeta` #4640](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4640)
  * [Ability to strip Emoji from downloaded file  #4836](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4836) / [File names use "full-width" special characters: '？' vs '?' #5014](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5014)
  * [[Youtube] Extract exact timestamps #1803](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1803)
  * [[Feature Request] Crop to square thumbnail when embedding in MP3s #429 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/429#issuecomment-2282554440)
  * Download only videos with subtitles 
    * `--parse-metadata "%(subtitles.\:.0.ext|)s:^(?!\[\])(?P<has_subs>.)" -v --match-filter has_subs`
  * [How do I rename previously-downloaded files with nothing but the youtube video ID? #5692](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5692)
  * Remove specific fields from info-json - [[Suggestion] Redact `formats` in info json with an option #455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/455#issuecomment-1367741786)
  * About subtitles in mp4 container - [Convert webvtt subtitles in mp4 into useable format #5833 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5833#issuecomment-1358246240)
  * [Find the API option for a CLI argument #5859 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/5859#issuecomment-1363938900)
    * Use <https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/devscripts/cli_to_api.py>
  * [[YouTube] `youtube:skip=translated_subs` doesn't work for some videos. #3875](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3875)
  * [Youtube bestvideo and vp9 preference. #1232 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1232#issuecomment-939635345)
  * [repo: git log broken by SSH signature #7322](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7322)
  * [download comments into separate comments.json file #2372 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/2372#issuecomment-1506413976)
  * [How to force a conversion to a specific video codec? #7607 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7607#issuecomment-1636960750)
  * [How to download youtube videos in mp4 format? #8880](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/8880)
  * [How do I properly pass my Soundcloud oauth token to yt-dlp? #12249 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12249#issuecomment-2628937389)
  * [[youtube] 256kbps music formats not being extracted #12455 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/12455#issuecomment-2677077342)
  * [[PYI-12704:ERROR] Failed to extract Cryptodome\Cipher_ARC4.pyd: decompression resulted in return code -1! #16522](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16522)
    * You probably don't have enough free disk space on the drive where your temp dir is located



**PS** : These are just the most common issues at the moment. Make sure to [search for duplicates](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=) in general before opening issues. Looking at this is not an excuse to not search for other duplicates!

## Description

[](https://github.com/nonopolarity)

[nonopolarity](https://github.com/nonopolarity)

opened [on Mar 19, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16279#issue-4100040104)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

To make it slow down a bit when downloading several videos in a channel, I may use
    
    
    --sleep-interval 180 --max-sleep-interval 300
    

which is to sleep 3 to 5 minutes between each download.

However, **I noticed that it even sleep before the first download, which appears unnecessary.**  
It only needs to be "between" each download. It doesn't need to be "before each download".

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output

## Description

[](https://github.com/Lithira-Amarasinghe)

[Lithira-Amarasinghe](https://github.com/Lithira-Amarasinghe)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

The main issue identified is format IDs are not standardized so when there are multiple Periods in a DASH-manifest it's difficult to decide the Period to which a specific Format is related. Following list is the Format IDs mentioned in the verbose output.

images_1-0,images_1-1, a0-0, a0-1, v2-0,v8, v1-0, v7, v4, v1-1, v0, v6-0, v3-0, v5-0

Based on the above Format ID list, we can see that some ids have structures like "a0-0" but some others have "v8" like structure. So it's confusing that which is the relevant Period of specific Format. As a result of that there is an ambiguity in selecting the audio and muted-video when a user need to download a specific Period.

This unidentifiability cause to download a wired video which means when user needed to download a specific Period, they may combine Formats that seems like related to that period but final output may be a combination of Formats in different Periods.

To ensure consistency and clarity, Format IDs should be standardized across the system. A structured format such as a0-0 or v2-0 is recommended, where the number following the hyphen indicates the corresponding Period ID. This approach makes Format IDs easier to read, manage, and trace back to their related periods

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Desired behavior:

  * User specifies a playlist URL
  * User specifies a download archive file
  * Any video in download archive gets skipped
  * Every video gets at least some basic metadata (extractor, ID, URL) included in output (via `-J` option, playlist `playlist` post-processor, return value `dict`, and/or `.info.json` file



Current behavior:

  * For non-skipped videos, extensive metadata is made available (via `-J`, to `playlist` processor, etc)
  * For skipped videos, no metadata is present whatsoever; `entries` does not have any indication of other videos; only a higher `playlist_count`



Related issues:

  * Current behavior may have been introduced with [-J with --download-archive returns undesirable 4-field-object entries #4369](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4369) (previously it may have been more similar to "desired behavior"); simply reverting related commit(s) may resolve this issue and enable this use case, but would probably cause others for other use cases. However, it provides some clues how to implement this one.
  * If [Add `--use-postprocessor` WHEN stage `before_playlist` #7034](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/7034) `before_playlist` were to be implemented, it may provide an alternative way to reach a similar goal. (i.e. make entire playlist basic metadata available outside of yt-dlp prior to removing entries from download archive) Suggest evaluating whether this issue or that makes more sense for implementation.



Design alternatives:

  * Include skipped video in `entries` list with dictionary item like `"skipped": True`
  * New config option that instructs yt-dlp to include metadata for skipped videos
  * Add a new list to output (alongside, not in, `entries` list) like `"skipped_entries": [{"ie_key": "extractor", "id": "abcd", "_type": "url", "url": "https://www.extractor.com/abcd"}, {"ie_key": "extractor", "id": "efgh", "_type": "url", "url": "https://www.extractor.com/efgh"}]`



For clarity, abbreviated simulated output illustrating debug output of encountering two videos ("video1" and "video2"), but JSON output excluding "video1" included.

I am willing to work on a pull request for this but looking for feedback on the feature itself and if there is a preference for one design over another.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When downloading a Youtube video where the thumbnail has previously been downloaded (such as if it's continuing a partial video download), the existence of thumbnail format 41 seems to be checked _before_ checking if there's a thumbnail already on disk. On the videos where thumbnail 41 _does_ exist, I've seen it download it again then overwrite the already-present thumbnail when converted to JPG by `--convert-thumbnails` (off the top of my head I don't immediately know any videos that have thumbnail 41 to show this, though).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# Support wreq as alternative to curl_cffi that works on FreeBSD #16577

Support wreq as alternative to curl_cffi that works on FreeBSD#16577

Copy link

Labels

[core:networkingcore networking related](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22core%3Anetworking%22)core networking related[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/dbohdan)

## Description

[](https://github.com/dbohdan)

[dbohdan](https://github.com/dbohdan)

opened [on Apr 26, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16577#issue-4330182519)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

One system I use yt-dlp on is a FreeBSD home server. A FreeBSD installation of yt-dlp is less capable than a Linux installation because curl_cffi doesn't support FreeBSD ([open issue](https://github.com/lexiforest/curl_cffi/issues/365)). The [wreq](https://github.com/0x676e67/wreq-python) library for Python is an HTTP client similar to curl_cffi. It can impersonate browsers with customizable TLS, JA3/JA4, and HTTP/2 fingerprints.

wreq is implemented in Rust and is easy to build on FreeBSD. I would like yt-dlp to support wreq as an installation option. This way FreeBSD users will have a curl_cffi-style HTTP client.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Hello, thank you so much for adding the "aria2c" feature, which is useful if the download speed is throttled ! 💯 🥇

However, it seems that "Surge" is faster than "aria2c" according to the benchmark tests conducted by the Surge Team.  
So it would be great please if amazing yt-dlp Team could add support for "Surge" download engine if it's not too technically complicated please. Thanks!

<https://github.com/surge-downloader/surge?tab=readme-ov-file#benchmarks>

Also, i think adding sequential download feature to yt-dlp is vital capital to allowing us to temporarily play TS videos while downloading—ideal when our Wi-Fi connection becomes too weak,

and

what caught my attention in "Surge" download engine is this feature:

"Sequential Download: Option to download files in strict order (Streaming Mode). Ideal for media files that you want to preview while downloading."

I'm not an expert, but if it's not too technically complex, it would be great please that great "yt-dlp" Team to add support for "Surge" as an alternative download engine to take advantage of sequential downloading to enjoy fast sequential download in order to preview/play video while downloading ideal for weak wifi connexion please, thanks!

<https://github.com/surge-downloader/surge>

# [Announcement] Bun support is now limited and deprecated #16766

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Closed

[#16786](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16786)

Closed

[Announcement] Bun support is now limited and deprecated#16766

[#16786](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16786)

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)[ejs/jscRelated to the JS Challenge framework and/or EJS library](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22ejs%2Fjsc%22)Related to the JS Challenge framework and/or EJS library

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on May 20, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16766#issue-4489404450)

Issue body actions

Due to foreseeable compatibility and security issues, yt-dlp's support for Bun as an [`ejs`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs)-compatible JavaScript runtime is being both limited and deprecated.

As of the next yt-dlp and/or ejs release, only Bun versions `1.2.11` through `1.3.14` will be supported. The rationale for this change is twofold:

  1. The minimum required version is being raised from `1.0.31` to `1.2.11` because building the `ejs` package with a version earlier than `1.2.0` results in the ejs lockfile being ignored, which is a significant security concern for users when considering all of the recent npm supply chain attacks. Additionally, the support floor is being bumped to `1.2.11` instead of `1.2.0` because the `ejs` test suite cannot be run with versions of Bun earlier than `1.2.11`.

  2. Bun was recently rewritten in Rust using Claude, and its development seems to have taken a turn towards being fully vibe-coded. This is alarming and disappointing for a number of reasons, and frankly it seems like a future headache that we'd prefer to avoid. We are adding a support ceiling of version `1.3.14`, as that is the last release built from the original zig codebase.




Bun support will also be deprecated. This means that while yt-dlp will continue to support this narrower range of Bun versions for as long as they're able to meet the needs of yt-dlp and ejs, we reserve the right to completely drop support for Bun should it at any point become too burdensome to maintain.

* * *

See [the EJS wiki article](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) for more information about supported JavaScript runtimes.

Reactions are currently unavailable

Pinned by [bashonly](/bashonly)

Pinned comment options

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)on May 24, 2026

Support for `bun>1.3.14` has now been dropped. **yt-dlp will allow the user to bring a newer version of bun** , but doing so will trigger a warning that informs the user their version is unsupported and directs them **not** to open a bug report. Any such bug reports will be ignored and closed. If you believe you've encountered an actual yt-dlp/ejs bug that should be brought to our attention, then reproduce the issue using a supported JS runtime/version.

This announcement thread was created solely to communicate with users of yt-dlp's bun integration: to communicate the upcoming changes to them, and so they could communicate feedback to us. (Note that this issue was created inbetween the similar [node](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16765) …

Option to immediately write comments to disk#16626

Copy link

[](https://github.com/BOplaid)

## Description

[](https://github.com/BOplaid)

[BOplaid](https://github.com/BOplaid)

opened [on May 3, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16626#issue-4371274778)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

(I only use yt-dlp for YouTube so I'm not sure if yt-dlp already does this with other sites, but writing comments to disk shouldn't be dependent on the site.)  
Normally, yt-dlp writes comments to disk right before the downloader is called (not sure but doesn't really matter here). This means that if yt-dlp is exited/killed for any reason in the middle of comment extraction, all the extracted comments are lost. An option that would make yt-dlp immediately write comments to disk would be nice.

Ignore the failure of initial data extraction in the log; that's (probably) because of my weird network which (essentially) forces a weird user agent on the network level no matter what I do, which causes a redirection to m.youtube.com. It works anyway though and I haven't had any problems.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/cboltz)

[cboltz](https://github.com/cboltz)

opened [on Mar 22, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16312#issue-4116067360)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a bug unrelated to a specific site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If I specify an invalid value for the -f parameter, I get a backtrace:
    
    
    # yt-dlp -vU -f hls-763+ https://www.zdf.de/filme/collection-index-page-ard-collection-ard-dxjuomfyzdpzag93ojg3mgrinzhlyjbhyje5nzk-108
      [... shortened, see "verbose output" section for complete output ...]
      File "/usr/lib/python3.13/site-packages/yt_dlp/YoutubeDL.py", line 2407, in _parse_format_selection
        raise syntax_error('Expected a selector', start)
    SyntaxError: Invalid format specification: Expected a selector
            hls-763+
    

Of course, `-f hls-763+` is obviously invalid since it misses the selected audio stream after the `+` (copy&paste error done by me) so it's correct that yt-dlp errors out.

However, I'd hope for a _more user-friendly error message_ instead of a backtrace. For example, yt-dlp could print something like `Error: value given for -f parameter is invalid.`

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

    [debug] Command-line config: ['--restrict-filenames', '-vU', '-f', 'hls-763+', 'https://www.zdf.de/filme/collection-index-page-ard-collection-ard-dxjuomfyzdpzag93ojg3mgrinzhlyjbhyje5nzk-108']

# Document setup of extras for non-PyPI installations #16224

New issue

Open

Document setup of extras for non-PyPI installations#16224

Copy link

Labels

[enhancementNew feature or request](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22enhancement%22)New feature or request[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/zahlman)

## Description

[](https://github.com/zahlman)

[zahlman](https://github.com/zahlman)

opened [on Mar 12, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16224#issue-4066913711)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

I'm a Python developer, so I can easily set up `yt-dlp` in a virtual environment, add dependencies to that environment based on the dependency groups in `pyproject.toml`, etc. But most users aren't in that situation.

In places where yt-dlp is discussed (such as the Linux Mint forums) I come across a fair number of people who have installed yt-dlp either through a system package manager, the zipapp or a compiled all-in-one package, and then want to install some extra or other. For example, most recently someone wanted to use the impersonation feature, which per the main documentation requires `[curl-cffi]`, not included in the zipapp (since this was on the Mint forums, I can pretty safely rule out the MUSL binary).

I have noticed that the zipapp uses a `#!/usr/bin/env python3` shebang, so in principle a Linux user could activate a virtual environment where the extra dependencies are installed before using the `yt-dlp` command (and possibly also e.g. wrap those two steps in a Bash function), but that's a lot to expect of most people (including those who are now migrating to Linux as Win11 continues to annoy everyone).

Meanwhile I expect that most people will do some research, try to set up those dependencies in the system environment, run into PEP 668 protections and then pester support forums to decide what to do about those protections. Right now this project's documentation just tells people to e.g. `pip install "yt-dlp[default,curl-cffi]"`, without any consideration of the target environment.

It would be good to either:

  * Build a system into `yt-dlp` that lets it manage its own venv and put some dependencies there;

  * Document how users are intended to obtain these dependencies (even if they aren't accustomed to Python packaging) and establish a stance on whether to install them in the system environment (i.e. whether users are expected to use `--break-system-packages`, include a reference to some Python documentation of the trade-offs etc.)




Whatever you think is the right way to do things is fine by me; I know how to do it many ways anyway. But if you do have an opinion, other users should understand that opinion, and how to act on it.

Alternately, I could write up a PR to add multiple ways of doing it to the Installation section of the wiki. But I don't really know the best way to organize it. (I also have a shelved wiki project of my own, generally about "installing Python stuff", that I could resume and reference...)

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below



### Complete Verbose Output
    
    
    Not applicable, as this is not about a specific problem from running the program (just documentation and/or simplification of the install process).

Reactions are currently unavailable

# [Announcement] Raising the minimum supported version of Deno to v2.3.0 #16767

New issue

Copy link

New issue

Copy link

Closed

[#16788](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16788)

Closed

[Announcement] Raising the minimum supported version of Deno to v2.3.0#16767

[#16788](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16788)

Copy link

Labels

[discussion/announcement](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22discussion%2Fannouncement%22)[ejs/jscRelated to the JS Challenge framework and/or EJS library](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22ejs%2Fjsc%22)Related to the JS Challenge framework and/or EJS library

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

## Description

[](https://github.com/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)

opened [on May 20, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16767#issue-4489757027)

Issue body actions

Deno is an [`ejs`](https://github.com/yt-dlp/ejs)-compatible JavaScript runtime.

As of the next yt-dlp and/or ejs release, the minimum supported version of Deno will be raised from `v2.0.0` to `v2.3.0`.

This is being done for security reasons: Deno v2.3.0 introduced a new lockfile format that is incompatible with earlier versions. The lockfile is not used at runtime, but it is necessary to safely build the package (e.g. if the user installs `ejs` from source or builds their own wheel). Cooldown support, which is crucial to avoiding npm supply chain attacks, was not introduced until Deno v2.6.0. So we are unable to generate a lockfile that is both protected by cooldown enforcement _and_ compatible with Deno versions earlier than v2.3.0. The clear solution is to raise the support floor for Deno.

* * *

See [the EJS wiki article](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/EJS) for more information about supported JavaScript runtimes.

Reactions are currently unavailable

Pinned by [bashonly](/bashonly)

[bashonly](https://github.com/bashonly)on May 20, 2026

See also:

  * [#16765](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16765)
  * [#16766](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16766)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If video hosting site is being blocked, often you need not only use a proxy to reach it, but also have to perform DNS lookup through that proxy, otherwise the lookup query is too easy to intercept and block or fake.  
One of the ways to route DNS through a proxy would be to use a DNS-over-HTTPS provider.  
Unfortunately, yt-dlp doesn't seem to support this functionality. There is the issue [#1231](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/1231) that asks for the ability to specify DNS server to use, but it does not mention DoH/DoT so I decided to create a separate issue instead.

Provided is an example yt-dlp output using youtube. Firefox running on the same machine and using the same proxy views youtube just fine. Proxy itself neither discriminates clients nor requires auth to work. The only difference I can see is Firefox having a DoH option enabled, and yt-dlp lacking it entirely.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

## Description

[](https://github.com/bcmryan)

[bcmryan](https://github.com/bcmryan)

opened [on May 30, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16837#issue-4554400233)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a feature unrelated to a specific site
  * I've looked through the [README](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#readme)
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

In addition to outputting .json information files, I am requesting a feature to also output to .nfo files that are compatible with frontends such as Jellyfin, Emby, and Plex. This could be accomplished by parsing and converting .json files to .nfo or outputing natively to .nfo, as is done with .json.

But why? Projects exist to convert yt-dlp .json files to .nfo but are not actively maintained (<https://github.com/unacro/yt-dlp-metadata2nfo>, <https://github.com/owdevel/ytdl-nfo>) and do not run on a current install of stock Ubuntu 26.04 with the base Python installation from apt (3.14.4). Wrappers around yt-dlp (e.g. <https://github.com/jmbannon/ytdl-sub>) also integrate this feature but are potentially too specific to one site (e.g. YouTube, thus excluding metadata from all other yt-dlp-supported sites).

Given the variety of implementations, there is clearly a demand for outputting metadata to .nfo files, and I believe that the yt-dlp team is the best positioned to maintain this functionality across websites while providing a consistent output regardless of whether downloading from the command line with yt-dlp or via an auxiliary program relying on yt-dlp.

[EDIT: As requested, more information has been added.]

See the .nfo specifications for [Jellyfin](https://jellyfin.org/docs/general/server/metadata/nfo/) and [Kodi](https://kodi.wiki/view/NFO_files). Compare these to the tags used by [yt-dlp](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#output-template).

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

id | `"id": "aqz-KE-bpKQ"`  
name/title/localtitle (all equivalent) | `"title": "Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K - Official Blender Foundation Short Film"`  
originaltitle | `"fulltitle": "Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K - Official Blender Foundation Short Film"`  
plot/biography/review (all equivalent) | `"description": "UHD High Frame rate version of the iconic short film by Blender, Big Buck Bunny. More info: https://studio.blender.org/projects/big-buck-bunny/\n\nLearn more about this UHD high frame-rate version at: http://bbb3d.renderfarming.net"`  
premiered/releasedate (not equivalent but either possible) | `"upload_date": "20141110"`  
dateadded | "timestamp": 1415628355  
runtime | `"duration_string": "10:35"` (Note "duration" tag lists time in seconds as in `"duration": 635` but it seems that the .nfo tag is for minutes; this may not be necessary at all as [Jellyfin ignores this and parses time itself](https://github.com/jellyfin/jellyfin/issues/13881))  
studio/director/credits/writer/actor (not equivalent but various possible) | `"uploader": "Blender"`  
studio/director/credits/writer/actor (not equivalent but various possible) | `"channel": "Blender"`  
genre | "categories": ["Film & Animation"]  
tag | `"tags": ["blender", "animation", "4K", "UHD", "Big Buck Bunny (Film)", "Blender Foundation (Nonprofit Organization)", "Short Film (Film Genre)", "4K Resolution"]`  
rating/customrating (all equivalent) | `"like_count": 108827` (Note "view_count" also possible as in `"view_count": 23219765`)  
thumb | `"thumbnail": "https://i.ytimg.com/vi/aqz-KE-bpKQ/maxresdefault.jpg"`  
trailer | `"webpage_url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ"`  
mpaa | `"age_limit": 0`

A roughly equivalent .nfo file would be
    
    
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
    
    <movie>
        <id>aqz-KE-bpKQ</id>
        <title>Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K - Official Blender Foundation Short Film</title>
        <originaltitle>Big Buck Bunny 60fps 4K - Official Blender Foundation Short Film</originaltitle>
        <plot>UHD High Frame rate version of the iconic short film by Blender, Big Buck Bunny. More info: https://studio.blender.org/projects/big-buck-bunny/
    
    Learn more about this UHD high frame-rate version at: http://bbb3d.renderfarming.net</plot>
        <premiered>2014-11-10</premiered>
        <releasedate>2014-11-10</releasedate>
        <dateadded>1415628355</dateadded>
        <studio>Blender</studio>
        <director>Blender</director>
        <genre>Film &amp; Animation</genre>
        <tag>blender</tag>
        <tag>animation</tag>
        <tag>4K</tag>
        <tag>UHD</tag>
        <tag>Big Buck Bunny (Film)</tag>
        <tag>Blender Foundation (Nonprofit Organization)</tag>
        <tag>Short Film (Film Genre)</tag>
        <tag>4K Resolution</tag>
        <rating>108827</rating>
        <thumb>https://i.ytimg.com/vi/aqz-KE-bpKQ/maxresdefault.jpg</thumb>
        <trailer>https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aqz-KE-bpKQ</trailer>
        <mpaa>G</mpaa>
    </movie>
    

Note that other tags are possible if considered a TV show: showtitle | `playlist_title`, episode | `playlist_index`.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

India

### Example URLs

  * <https://www.stage.in/hi/haryanvi/movie/harta-ishq-17041>



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

stage.in is, I would assume, operating only in India, and is not currently supported. I tried implementing the extractor, but seems way beyond my understanding.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm requesting a site-specific feature
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

France

### Example URLs

<https://t18.fr/prog/non-elucide-17012/l-affaire-janvier-1000041768>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Support request for replay videos hosted on t18.fr.

The website appears to use an embedded Dailymotion player.

Example embedded player URL:  
<https://geo.dailymotion.com/player/x1inbe.html?video=k2EnE9WlTGNDVLFJXo4>

Direct extraction through the Dailymotion extractor fails with:  
ERROR: [dailymotion] k2EnE9WlTGNDVLFJXo4: dailymotion said: Contenu privé.

The replay video is publicly playable in a regular browser on the T18 website.

The player JavaScript appears to use a dynamically forwarded authentication token (UPDATE_AUTH_TOKEN / forwardAuthToken), suggesting the stream URL is generated dynamically for embedded playback.

This may require:

  * extracting an auth token from the page/player,
  * reproducing embed headers/referer,
  * or retrieving the final HLS/DASH manifest URL from the embedded player API.



### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

Site (re)request: Mnet Plus (mnetplus.world)#16715

[#16774](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/pull/16774)

[site-requestRequest to support a new website](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22site-request%22)Request to support a new website[triageUntriaged issue](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=state%3Aopen%20label%3A%22triage%22)Untriaged issue

[](https://github.com/vikanezrimaya)

## Description

[](https://github.com/vikanezrimaya)

[vikanezrimaya](https://github.com/vikanezrimaya)

opened [on May 13, 2026](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/16715#issue-4440700935)

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Presumably worldwide, tested with a German IP

### Example URLs

<https://www.mnetplus.world/media/en/videos/69f3460e9a8140759c0b3a1d>

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

mnet plus seems to restrict yt-dlp as-is to only download a 10-second preview of the test case above; full video is 48 minutes long. Amusingly, I was able to download it by peeking into the browser console — copious use of the "copy as curl" menu option was enough to extract their HLS playlist, understand where the video comes from, download video, audio and even subtitles (in weird JSON-like format, timestamped with second-level granularity).

Seems like there was an `mnet` extractor before, but it got removed due to being broken. Developing a new one from scratch shouldn't be hard — fake enough headers to look like a browser, plug in the cookies (logged-out users only get a 10-second preview or 403 errors on full video HLS), download the full HLS playlist and go from there. Oh, and figure out the subtitles. :3

As said above, website requires being logged-in, but making an account is free and does not require payment; payment is only required for 1080p videos and allegedly ad-free experience (but with a good adblocker I'm yet to see an ad on their website), but 720p quality should be okay as an initial test case. Therefore I don't think sharing credentials will be needed, as I don't have their subscription anyway.

**Some notes about the verbose invocation below** : ffmpeg error is unrelated; I was just running to check if the extractor was (re)added in master. The files that ended up downloading are 10-seconds long, as stated above; my cookies did not seem to be sufficient. Additionally my config demands subtitles to be downloaded and baked in; since mnet uses a non-standard subtitles format, a custom extractor seems necessary and justified.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

Italy

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

yt-dlp answer is: yt_dlp.utils.UnsupportedError: Unsupported URL: <https://www.onepodcast.it/brand/onepodcast/2026/05/21/audio/il_prezzo_nascosto_del_digitale-21961623/>

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

Issue body actions

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required



### Region

United Kingdom

### Example URLs

Note that Live links are usually only available for a few days after broadcast, so most of these links will break soon after posting this issue.

  * <https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/Live> (livestream)
  * <https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/Live/pafiliwn-gwyn-6> (VOD)
  * <https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/Live/pafiliwn-gwyrdd-7> (VOD)
  * <https://www.s4c.cymru/clic/Live/pafiliwn-coch-1> (livestream as I write this, possibly VOD later)



### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

S4C Clic often has Live links for recent broadcasts of major events such as the Eisteddfod. Some of these make it to normal `/programme/` links (which are supported by yt-dlp), but some don't. It'd be great to be able to download them, at least the VODs but preferably including the livestreams.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting a new site support request

  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that none of provided URLs [violate any copyrights](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#is-the-website-primarily-used-for-piracy) or contain any [DRM](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_rights_management) to the best of my knowledge
  * I've searched the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar requests **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates

  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and am willing to share it if required

### Example URLs

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

TikTok [very] recently added highlights to profiles, same feature as Instagram.  
So far I've only noticed it on one profile, but the strange thing is, I can only see it from one of my accounts. Looking at the same profile from a different account, I don't see the highlights. I don't follow either accounts, so I'm not sure what the requirements to view these highlights are.

Profile in question: <https://www.tiktok.com/@ydal_0>

It only seems to be visible on mobile. Screenshots attached.  
Viewing the highlights, you can't copy any links, as you can do with stories.

Whatever information is needed, I can do my best to try provide and/or find, I just don't know what to look for.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

Iran

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

telewebion.com no longer exists. Probably the regex should be updated.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

Germany

Deno or alternate JS runtime is not installed.

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

US

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

While downloading, yt-dlp shows a series of 502 bad gateway errors and eventually fails. This happens at different times during the download if repeated. Some downloads finish with missing fragments and are unplayable.

At the same time the above started, curl errors (connection reset) also appeared during the m3u8 download stage - but I am unsure how this is related to the downloads failing.

I have tried aria2 external downlaoder for troubleshooting purposes, but it also fails hard with error code 29.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Example URLs

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Soundcloud has comment support, and currently --write-comments does nothing on Soundcloud.  
I did find two issues: [#3929](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3929) and [#4015](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/4015). The first one was closed without explanation, being initially labelled as "duplicate" (of what?!) and then as "spam". The second one was (correctly) marked as a duplicate of [#3929](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3929).  
But why was [#3929](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3929) closed in the first place? I can't find any other issue that suggests it's a duplicate, nor is there any reasoning in [#3929](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3929) as there are no comments.

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

Currently there is no real documentation on the clients (e.g. `tv` and its variants, `android` and its variants, `web` and its variants, etc.) besides [the docs for the `player_client` extractor arg](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#youtube) but I would argue that that is incomplete.  
For example it doesn't specify characteristics of clients (e.g. do they need cookies? do they only provide SABR? how wide is their selection of formats compared to some other client? do they work with `--live-from-start`? etc.), why they're used (or not) instead of some other client (and an issue if applicable), etc. Also what the client actually is; for example considering there is a `web_safari` one would wonder what browser (or UA string ig) the normal `web` is. For example this sort of this description would (to my knowledge, which consists of hours of browsing through the issue tracker here) be suitable for the `android_vr` client: "Doesn't need cookies and doesn't provide SABR. Default client when cookies aren't provided (otherwise `tv_downgraded`). [Sometimes not all tracks of format 140 appear/Sometimes doesn't yield audio formats for all languages](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/15756)."

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)

  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

_No response_

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

If you look at this URL: <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BJ0xBCwkg3E>  
You'll see there are 85150 comments (as of the time of this writing).  
However, the below log (which didn't fit) shows that yt-dlp only manages to get 8505.  
(don't mind the 403; my connection to api.github.com is really flaky)

  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required

### Checklist

  * I'm reporting that yt-dlp is broken on a **supported** site
  * I've verified that I have **updated yt-dlp to nightly or master** ([update instructions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp#update-channels))
  * I've checked that all provided URLs are playable in a browser with the same IP and same login details
  * I've checked that all URLs and arguments with special characters are [properly quoted or escaped](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ#video-url-contains-an-ampersand--and-im-getting-some-strange-output-1-2839-or-v-is-not-recognized-as-an-internal-or-external-command)
  * I've searched [known issues](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/3766), [the FAQ](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/wiki/FAQ), and the [bugtracker](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20-label%3Aspam%20%20) for similar issues **including closed ones**. DO NOT post duplicates
  * I've read the [policy against AI/LLM contributions](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#automated-contributions-ai--llm-policy) and understand I may be blocked from the repository if it is violated
  * I've read about [sharing account credentials](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#are-you-willing-to-share-account-details-if-needed) and I'm willing to share it if required



### Region

EU

### Provide a description that is worded well enough to be understood

When trying to download an eBay listing's video, something that worked ~1 month ago, I receive `Unable to download webpage: HTTP Error 403: Forbidden (caused by <HTTPError 403: Forbidden>)`.  
I have tried numerous listings, all behave the same. yt-dlp is up to date, `master@2026.05.25.232152`.

### Provide verbose output that clearly demonstrates the problem

  * Run **your** yt-dlp command with **-vU** flag added (`yt-dlp -vU <your command line>`)
  * If using API, add `'verbose': True` to `YoutubeDL` params instead
  * Copy the WHOLE output (starting with `[debug] Command-line config`) and insert it below

# [Twitch] Obtaining clip display_id from id alone #16841
